single-file html dashboard, all in one. big clock, my three tasks with checkboxes that actually stick after a refresh, and a lil streak counter for days opened. cream bg, ink text, one accent color, no purple, no gradients, works offline by double-clicking. can you spec that out first, not just code it

The spec first. One HTML file, no build step, no network: open by double-click, works with the wifi off. Chrome, Safari and Firefox all allow localStorage on a file:// URL, so persistence survives refresh and restart.

Storage, two keys: avy.tasks, an array of three objects {text, done}, seeded on first run if missing; avy.days, an array of "YYYY-MM-DD" strings, computed in local time, never UTC, or the streak breaks for anyone west of Greenwich in the evening.

Streak render, on load: sort the dates descending; if the newest is not today or yesterday, streak is 0 (or show "1" only if today is present). Walk backwards from the most recent, counting consecutive days with a gap of exactly one. If today is missing but yesterday is present, the count still shows the live run but the display marks it as at risk, e.g. "8 — today pending."

Layout, top to bottom, all in one column, max-width around 640px, centered: clock at roughly 20vw clamped to 140px max, light weight, tabular numerals so the digits don't jitter each second; date underneath in small caps; three rows, checkbox plus label, 44px tall for touch, struck through and dimmed when checked; streak at the bottom, one line, small.

Theme, tokens at the top of the file: --cream #F7F2E7, --ink #1C1A17, --muted #8A8175, --accent a single rust-orange #C2410C. No gradients, no purple, no shadows beyond a hairline border. System font stack (ui-serif or -apple-system), no webfonts since they'd need the network.

Accessibility: native checkboxes, labels tied by for/id, focus ring in the accent, prefers-reduced-motion respected, and prefers-color-scheme dark mapping to ink background and cream text, same single accent.

Behavior details worth deciding: the clock ticks with a self-correcting timer rather than setInterval alone, so a laptop waking from sleep doesn't drift, and it recomputes the date each tick and rolls the streak over if midnight passes while the tab is open. Write on every change, synchronous, no debounce for something this small. Catch Storage quota or privacy-mode throws and fall back to in-memory so it doesn't look broken.

Failure mode to accept: file:// localStorage is per-origin and some setups share it across all local files, so a second copy of the dashboard in another folder could see the same keys. If that matters, namespace the keys with a constant you can change by hand.

Open choices in the spec where I'd pick: task text editable in place by clicking the label (a plain contenteditable on a span, saved on blur); a "reset" only under a long-press or hidden behind the date; and midnight rollover recomputed on visibility change rather than a scheduled timer, which is more robust on a sleeping machine.

Want me to build it to that, or adjust any of those calls first?

Here's the whole thing as a file so it's actually one document, not a message that can truncate:

```markdown
# Dashboard spec

One file, index.html. No build, no network, opens by double-click, works offline.
localStorage on file:// works in Chrome, Safari, Firefox.

## Storage
- avy.tasks: [{text, done}] x3, seeded on first run
- avy.days: ["YYYY-MM-DD"] local dates, never UTC
- keys constants at top of file, rename by hand if a second copy collides
- try/catch writes; fall back to memory so the UI never looks broken

## Streak
- sort days desc; absent today and yesterday => 0
- count consecutive days back from newest
- yesterday-only => show count plus "today pending"
- recompute on tick, visibilitychange, and midnight crossing

## Layout
Column, max-width 640, centered. Clock ~20vw, max 140px, tabular numerals.
Date small caps under it. Three rows, 44px, checkbox + label, struck and dimmed
when done. Streak one line at the bottom.

## Theme
--cream #F7F2E7, --ink #1C1A17, --muted #8A8175, --accent #C2410C.
No gradients, no purple, hairline borders only, system font stack.
Dark via prefers-color-scheme, same single accent.

## Behavior
- self-correcting clock timer, not bare setInterval
- native checkboxes, label for/id, accent focus ring
- click label to edit text, save on blur
- write synchronously on every change
- no reset button (keyboard shortcut only)

## Accepted failure
file:// localStorage is per-origin on some setups, so two copies can share keys.
```
